subject: Renewal: evidence snapshot and capacity uplift for Q1 migration
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@acmecloud.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chan <olivia@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Dec 2029 16:12:05 +0000
Subject: Renewal — SOC 2 re-attestation and retention ask

Hi Sergio,

We’re kicking off our renewal planning and the audit team flagged a couple of asks that will affect the contract terms. Quick summary: we need evidence for a SOC 2 re-attestation window in Q1, and procurement is asking for a retention bump from 90 days to 180 days for audit logs during the attestation period.

Two practical requests from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a staged evidence handoff (sample -> bulk export -> post-audit snapshot)?
- We also anticipate needing temporary capacity to run ingest/queries during the audit window — estimate ~6TB total over a 30–45 day burst.

I attached the request packet (Acme_Soc2_Request.pdf) with format expectations. Can you share a high-level ops plan and an uplift/temporary-burst pricing? Procurement (procurement@acmecloud.com) is looped in.

Also: is KMS-managed keying compatible with your evidence exports?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Security Program Manager
Acme Cloud, Inc.

Attachment: Acme_Soc2_Request.pdf

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Olivia Chan <olivia@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Dec 2029 17:05:22 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal — SOC 2 re-attestation and retention ask

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the packet. We can support a three-phase evidence snapshot flow and we have two pricing paths for capacity: temporary burst or permanent tier uplift. High-level proposal below.

Proposed evidence handoff (short):
1) Pre-audit sample (T-30): 2 weeks of representative artifacts we stage in a secure bucket for reviewer access.
2) Bulk export (during audit): bulk log/export window with TTL controls and a read-only snapshot.
3) Post-audit frozen snapshot (T+7): final artifacts retained per agreed retention window.

Retention/keys: we support customer-managed KMS for exports and can deliver artifacts encrypted under your key.

Capacity options (ballpark):
- Temporary burst: +60 days of burst capacity (on top of current commitment) — one-time staging fee + usage-based tokens for burst.
- Permanent tier uplift: move to the next seat/throughput tier with a 12-month commitment and a discount on burst events.

Next steps: if this sounds right I’ll loop in our ops lead (Vanessa) to validate technical sizing and our legal lead (Kimberly) to prepare a short addendum. Can we pick a 30-min sync on Thu Dec 5? I’ll draft a mutual action plan (MOP) after the call.

I’ve attached our evidence playbook outline for reference.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_evidence_playbook_v1.pdf

Thanks for the detail, Olivia/Alex. Technical notes and two actionable pricing paths below.

Technical feasibility:
- We can support 180-day retention for audit logs. For the volumes stated (~6TB + API traces), we recommend a parallel export pipeline to avoid impact on production SLOs.
- Customer-managed KMS supported; we’ll deliver encrypted artifacts and a SHA256 manifest per file.

Option A — Temporary burst (recommended if retention is time-bound):
- 60-day burst capacity (handles bulk export and query windows)
- Staging fee: $6k one-time (includes secure staging bucket, manifests, and reviewer access)
- Usage: tokenized per-GB token pricing during burst (estimated $0.11/GB for exported artifacts)

Option B — Permanent tier uplift (recommended if you want predictable long-term throughput):
- Move to Tier-3 throughput seat: +25% baseline throughput, 12-month commit, 15% discounted rate on burst events
- One-time addendum required; we can include an evidence-retention carveout for audits

Legal/process notes: Kimberly — can you draft a short addendum that covers: retention window change (time-boxed), KMS responsibilities, and staged evidence access terms? We’ll also prepare a DocuSign addendum stub to speed procurement review.

Drive playbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-evidence-playbook

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
